1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2.
The application stands disposed of.

3. By way of the present application, the applicant seeks grant of regular bail in FIR No.566/2023 under Sections 376/506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC) registered at Police Station, Dwarka South.
4. Applicant has been in judicial custody since 26th November, 2023.

5. Counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant was in a consensual relationship with respondent no.2 hence, the allegation of rape is false.
6. Issue Notice.
